## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D Souls-like rhythm-action game for phones and tablets, focused on deflect combat with forgiving balance.

## Requirements
- “This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game).”
- Support phone/tablet play with usable touch controls.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks; read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built **ASHEN — The Last Bell**, a standalone browser game using Three.js from a CDN and a custom low-poly shrine duel scene.
- Implemented one boss encounter with readable attack tells, deflect/posture mechanics, strikes, dodge steps, healing, and keyboard/touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the responsive game in `index.html`, with intro/result screens, HUD, keyboard and touch controls, Three.js environment, and duel logic.
- Adjusted enemy approach so it begins attacks only within combat range; extended attack tells and deflect duration.
- Verified a timed deflect displays `PERFECT DEFLECT`, increases enemy posture to about 34%, and leaves player health unchanged.
- Verified strikes can reduce enemy health; JavaScript syntax check passed with `node --check /tmp/opencode/game-check.mjs`.

### Active
- Finish gameplay validation, including repeated deflects, dodge, heal, win/lose outcomes, and touch controls.
- Remove temporary `window.__ashenDebug` diagnostic hook after validation.
- Save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot after final checks.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test dodge, healing, repeated deflects, and both encounter outcomes; fix any issues found.
2. Check touch controls and mobile layout at phone/tablet viewport sizes.
3. Remove the temporary debug hook, rerun syntax validation, and save/read the latest screenshot.
4. Report implementation and any assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: complete game implementation; current gameplay and mobile-control changes.
- `screenshots/ashen-intro.jpg`: prior intro visual check.
- `screenshots/ashen-duel.jpg`: prior active-duel visual check; predates the latest gameplay changes.

## Important Context
- Browser check URL: `http://localhost:3002`.
